title: Alike in colour, different in voice
odia:
କାଉ କୋଇଲି ଏକା ବର୍ଣ୍ଣ
ରାବିଲା ବେଳେ ଭିନ୍ନ ଭିନ୍ନ।
literal_meaning: The crow and koel are the same colour; when they call, they sound different.
meaning_odia: ଦେଖିବାକୁ ଏକା ପରି ଲାଗିଲେ ମଧ୍ୟ କଥାବାର୍ତ୍ତା ବା ପ୍ରକାଶରେ ଫରକ ଜଣାପଡ଼େ। କାଉ ଓ କୋଇଲିର ରଙ୍ଗର ସାମ୍ୟ ସହ ସେମାନଙ୍କ ଅଲଗା ରାବକୁ ମିଳାଇ ଏହି କଥା କୁହାଯାଇଛି।
explanation: Outward resemblance does not tell the whole story. In the saying, birds that look alike are distinguished as soon as they call. Applied to people, the image suggests that speech or expression can reveal differences that appearance leaves hidden; this application is editorial.
usage_example: Two presenters arrive in equally polished clothes, but their explanations reveal very different levels of preparation. A listener recalls the saying. This illustration is newly composed.
cultural_context: The verse moves from seeing to hearing. Its first half groups the two birds together by colour; the repeated ଭିନ୍ନ in the second separates them through their voices. That change of sense carries the comparison.

witnesses.locator: Page9, two lines beginning କାଉ କୋଇଲି ଏକା ବର୍ଣ୍ଣ.

odia_summary: ଚେହେରାର ସାମ୍ୟ ଥିଲେ ବି କଥାରେ ଫରକ ଜଣାପଡ଼େ।
english_summary: Similar appearances can conceal differences revealed by voice.
